blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon – The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) District No. 99 in Bukidnon is on track to meet its P3.96 billion 2026 collection target in the province on or before December 31, an official said. Lawrence Cabeltes, newly installed BIR-99 Bukidnon district chief, said the district already collected P3.69 billion, or 91.49 percent of its annual goal, as of Monday, leaving a manageable P337.2 million balance for the rest of the year.
